# Salvia

> Salvia turns a post-encounter voice note into a policy-checked, audit-locked clinical record before anyone signs off. AI + audio + clinical documentation + compliance, built for every clinical specialty. Not a scribe — a compliance suite.

Salvia is a clinical governance automation platform. Clinicians dictate a post-encounter voice note; Salvia transcribes, extracts structured fields into the right statutory form, runs it against the clinic's linked regulatory framework pack, and locks the record with an audit trail. Every note checks itself. Every record defends itself.

Salvia is domain-agnostic. The first beachhead market is veterinary clinics in New Zealand, with parallel pilots in UK dental and allied health (physio).

## Product pillars

- [Point-of-Care Evidence](https://hellosalvia.com/products/point-of-care-evidence): Audio capture → transcription → structured field extraction → typed clinical record.
- [Statutory Form Infrastructure](https://hellosalvia.com/products/statutory-form-infrastructure): Jurisdiction- and vertical-specific forms with typed widgets (consent, drug register, incident, pain scale) — never free text where structure is required.
- [Institutional Compliance Hub](https://hellosalvia.com/products/institutional-compliance-hub): Policy framework linked to forms; every submission is policy-checked pre sign-off, with full audit trail and PDF export themed per clinic.

## Verticals

- [Veterinary](https://hellosalvia.com/veterinary): RCVS PSS (UK), VCNZ (NZ), AVA Code (AU), CMA September 2026 remedies (UK). Lead beachhead market.
- [Dental](https://hellosalvia.com/dental): CQC Regulation 17 (UK), GDC Standards, AHPRA Dental Board (AU), ARPANSA radiograph (AU).
- [General practice](https://hellosalvia.com/general-practice): CQC, AHPRA Medical Board, MCNZ, RACGP, BESTPRACTICE.
- [Allied health](https://hellosalvia.com/allied-health): CORU (IE), HCPC (UK), AHPRA boards (AU), PBNZ/OTBNZ/OCNZ/CBNZ (NZ), GOsC, GCC. Six disciplines as dedicated pages.

## Allied health disciplines

- [Physiotherapy](https://hellosalvia.com/physiotherapy): CORU (IE), HCPC (UK), AHPRA Physiotherapy Board (AU), PBNZ (NZ), FSBPT (US). Outcome measures (NPRS, ODI, NDI, LEFS).
- [Osteopathy](https://hellosalvia.com/osteopathy): GOsC (UK), AHPRA Osteopathy Board (AU), OCNZ (NZ). OPS Standard D6 record format.
- [Chiropractic](https://hellosalvia.com/chiropractic): GCC (UK), AHPRA Chiropractic Board (AU), CBNZ (NZ). GCC Code C3 alignment.
- [Occupational therapy](https://hellosalvia.com/occupational-therapy): CORU (IE), HCPC (UK), AHPRA OT Board (AU), OTBNZ (NZ), NBCOT (US). Goal-setting + ADL tracking.
- [Podiatry](https://hellosalvia.com/podiatry): CORU (IE), HCPC (UK), AHPRA Podiatry Board (AU), Podiatrists Board NZ. Wound register + sharps log.
- [Speech & language therapy](https://hellosalvia.com/speech-therapy): CORU (IE), HCPC (UK), Speech Pathology Australia, NZSTA, ASHA (US).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://hellosalvia.com/)
- [Pricing](https://hellosalvia.com/pricing): Two tiers — Practice (1-3 clinicians) and Pro (4-7). Five markets: US, NZ, AU, UK, Europe. No solo tier. Group/Enterprise above Pro.
- [Frameworks](https://hellosalvia.com/frameworks): Public catalog of every regulatory framework Salvia generates records against. Filter by country, vertical, discipline. Currently 40+ frameworks across 5 countries.
- [Contact sales](https://hellosalvia.com/contact-sales)
- [Early access signup](https://hellosalvia.com/start)

## Regulatory frameworks supported

Salvia ships a hand-curated regulatory framework pack per clinic context (country + vertical + discipline). The pack splices into every AI form-gen prompt automatically.

- Ireland: CORU (Physiotherapists, OT, Podiatry, SLT registration boards).
- UK: RCVS PSS, CMA Remedies, VMR, CQC Reg 17, GDC, HCPC, GOsC, GCC.
- Australia: AHPRA Boards (Vet, Medical, Dental, Physiotherapy, OT, Osteopathy, Chiropractic, Podiatry), ARPANSA, AVA, SPA.
- New Zealand: VCNZ, NZDA, MCNZ, BESTPRACTICE, PBNZ, OTBNZ, OCNZ, CBNZ, Podiatrists Board, NZSTA.
- United States: AVMA, AAHA, ADA CDT, FSBPT, NBCOT, NBCE, APMA, ASHA, HIPAA.
- Cross-cutting: GDPR (EU/UK), ISO 27001.
